facts.fact: OADC Lagos (LOS1), a carrier-neutral data centre owned by WIOCC's Open Access Data Centres, is operating in Lagos with up to 20MW load capacity and 3,200 racks; Equiano landed there in April 2022 (Submarine Networks).

MDXi Lagos, a carrier-neutral data centre operated by MDXi (MainOne, an Equinix company), is built and operating in Lagos and hosts the IXPN exchange; the page is dated 2026-07-16 and gives no opening date.
Rack Centre LGS 1 in Lagos, up to 1.5MW load capacity and 1,094 sqm of rack space, is built and in use; no opening date given, page dated 2026-07-16.
Rack Centre LGS 2 in Lagos, up to 12MW load capacity and 3,240 sqm of rack space, is built and offering rack space; no opening date given, page dated 2026-07-16.

note: Kasi Cloud hyperscale Tier IV facility is described as under construction, expected 2024: not a fact. No tier statement for in-service centres; no cloud region.
